title: the Sepik Basin Rising
author: Coral Sterling
blurb: Lena Amberdale, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
